entities.name: Requested MBS container
entities.description: Information element included in messages when the UE requests to join or leave one or more MBS sessions associated with the PDU session.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates MBS session join or leave requests.

entities.name: MBS session
entities.description: Multicast/broadcast service session that can be joined or left by the UE.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: Packet Data Unit session with which MBS sessions are associated.

relations.description: The Requested MBS container IE is included when the UE requests to join or leave MBS sessions.
The IE contains information about MBS sessions that the UE wants to join or leave.
MBS sessions are associated with a PDU session.
